headline: Oil slips on Iran talks, while tech drags the Nasdaq and the Dow tops 50,000
paragraphs: Oil eased on Tuesday, with Brent slipping below US$90 a barrel to around US$88 as traders weighed progress in US–Iran negotiations. A deal that brings more Iranian barrels back to market would loosen supply, so the market is trimming some of the risk premium it had built in.

On Wall Street the picture was split. The Dow closed above 50,000 for the first time as investors rotated into value stocks, but the S&P 500 fell about 0.5% and the Nasdaq led declines as doubts over AI spending weighed on big tech. Investors don't seem to be leaving equities; they are rethinking how much they will pay for growth.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance: Tech sell-off drags Nasdaq
